rule:
CS-related faculty outside the listed CS / EE faculty (owner decision 2026-10-22: "All universities should include all
faculty that work on CS-related topics / publish in CS venues (Even if not in CS)"), for Stanford.

candidates  tools/cs_related_candidates.py's rule on raw/author_stats.json.gz (one pass over the Stanford sweep): an
            OpenAlex author with >= 8 Stanford works 2016-2026, >= 5 of them DBLP-indexed (DBLP dump index) and >= 20% so,
            last author on >= 30% of them or >= 30 works, active in >= 3 distinct years, whose names match no census
            person -> hierarchy/stanford/cs-related-candidates.json
review      each candidate's Stanford Profiles page (live; slug guessed from the OpenAlex names, <h1> must match):
              faculty      the profile's title (h2) or an Academic Appointment is a professor rank (Professor, Associate /
                           Assistant Professor, incl. (Research) / (Teaching) / Emeritus); instructors, lecturers,
                           research staff, postdocs, students and clinical / adjunct-only titles are not faculty
              PI           the profile lists Doctoral Dissertation Advisor / Co-Advisor (AC) / Doctoral (Program) advisees
                           (advises_phd) or Postdoctoral Faculty Sponsor / Research Mentor advisees (advises_postdoc), or a
                           2016-2026 SDR dissertation names them degree supervisor
              period       start: the earliest dated evidence of a professor-rank appointment -- a Wayback capture of the
                           profile (year), or the profile Bio's own 'joined Stanford in YYYY' / 'at Stanford since YYYY'
                           sentence -- capped below at 2016 (the window); end: none (the live profile, asof today) unless
                           the title is Emeritus (end = the first emeritus capture's year is not claimed; asof kept)
            decisions: accepted | faculty_no_pi_evidence | not_faculty | no_profile
-> hierarchy/stanford/cs-related-review.json, census/stanford-additions.json (accepted), people/cs_related_profiles.json
usage: st_cs_related.py candidates | profiles | wayback | review
